fixturePrerequisites: The owned Places fixture must declare these four case identifiers before they can run; an undeclared case is refused at reset, so today these identities fail at setup rather than reporting a pass.
The owned Places seed plan must seed one list whose complete active membership is the complete70 acceptance size. 70 is an acceptance fixture size, never a product pin cap.

The owned Places fixture must supply its labelled synthetic place-pins policy. With no policy configured the feature is correctly unavailable and these identities cannot pass; no client default may stand in for it.
The existing resource-free contract that pins the declared Places case list at four entries belongs to the fixture owner and must be updated with those declarations.
